name: trocode
description: A general-purpose, goal-driven desktop agent powered by CUA.

scripts.start: npm run db:up && doppler run --project tro-app --config dev -- tauri dev
scripts.db:down: doppler run --project tro-app --config dev -- docker compose down
scripts.db:logs: doppler run --project tro-app --config dev -- docker compose logs --tail=100 postgres
scripts.db:ps: doppler run --project tro-app --config dev -- docker compose ps
scripts.db:up: doppler run --project tro-app --config dev -- docker compose up -d --wait --wait-timeout 60 postgres
scripts.package: doppler run --project tro-app --config prd -- tauri build
scripts.package:dev: doppler run --project tro-app --config dev -- tauri build --debug
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:no-backend-js && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
